en.text: Direct taxes differ from indirect taxes in that

zh.text: 直接稅與間接稅的分別在於直接稅

en.text: direct taxes are collected directly from the taxpayers but indirect taxes are not.

zh.text: 是直接向納稅人收取的，但間接稅則不是。

en.text: direct taxes are progressive whereas indirect taxes are regressive.

zh.text: 是累進的，而間接稅是累退的。

en.text: the tax burden of direct taxes cannot be shifted but that of indirect taxes can.

zh.text: 稅項負擔不能轉嫁，但間接稅則可以。

en.text: the direct tax revenue fluctuates with national income but the indirect tax revenue does not.

zh.text: 稅收隨國民收入增減而增減，但間接稅則不是。

en.text: Which of the following is/are the difference(s) between a direct tax and an indirect tax?

zh.text: 下列哪一 (幾) 項是直接稅與間接稅的分別？

en.text: The tax burden of a direct tax cannot be shifted onto other people, but the tax burden of an indirect tax can.

zh.text: 直接稅的課稅負擔不能轉嫁他人，間接稅的課稅負擔則可以。

en.text: A direct tax results in a more even income distribution, but an indirect tax results in a less even income distribution.

zh.text: 直接稅令收入分配更平均，間接稅令收入分配更不平均。

en.text: The tax base of direct taxes is narrower, but the tax base of indirect taxes is broader.

zh.text: 直接稅的稅基較窄，間接稅的稅基較闊。

en.text: All of the above are correct.
